capabilities: Embed Anki decks in notes via anki code blocks or open them in full editor views
Review flashcards with flip animations, rating buttons, and session statistics
Rate cards and sync review status back to Anki
Import CSV/TSV data into Anki decks through a guided modal
Call AnkiConnect API endpoints for decks, cards, notes, media, and sync
extras: Review time statistics log as 0 seconds with official AnkiConnect; the author ships a custom AnkiConnect fork (.ankiaddon) that must be installed in Anki and enabled in settings to fix this. Mobile and headless use require hosting anki-docker-server on a remote VPS and pointing the AnkiConnect URL setting at it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review Anki flashcards inside notes, forcing users to switch to the Anki app to study.

relations.evidence: embeds interactive Anki flashcard decks directly into your notes using AnkiConnect
Full AnkiConnect API Coverage: Strongly-typed wrappers for all 40+ AnkiConnect endpoints
We provide a heavily modified Custom AnkiConnect Fork that adds time-tracking capabilities

requires.name: Anki with the AnkiConnect add-on (code 2055492159) running locally, or a remote anki-docker-server for mobile/headless use

summary: Embeds interactive Anki flashcard decks in notes and full editor views, with card review, rating, and sync via AnkiConnect.
